title: Engine migration — Astro → Rust core + TS/Vite frontend, one global agentks install
description: Move the engine off Astro onto a Rust engine shared with the CLI, serving a Vite single-page app over one WebSocket. agentks becomes tool + engine + published frontend, installed once per machine. Phase 1 renders, Phase 2 adds editing and the dev toolkit, Phase 3 publishes with agentks build (SSG from shared layout components). Also the Neuralabs launch: repositories, homepage and hosted docs. Includes the config simplification, the ~/.agentks home and build cache, the agentks rename, forced migrations, dropping custom layouts, the agentks docs command and libraries via config/dep.yaml. The discussion (decisions, open questions, future stages) lives in brainstorm/; notes/ is reserved for the design, by component.
author: claude
